items.statement: Baidu announced ERNIE Bot on 16 March 2023, stating that it would be accessible to invited users from that day and that its API would be available on application to enterprise clients through Baidu AI Cloud.

time.note: Dateline and distribution date of the press release. Baidu's 20-F filed on 15 March 2024 places the ERNIE Bot launch in the quarter from January to March 2023; the date of general public availability is not established by these sources.

items.qualification: Invitation-based access is the stage the release states; it is not general public availability. The release's capability descriptions and enterprise application figures are Baidu's own statements and are not recorded as facts.
